Use case: ui-mockup. Create a beautifully art-directed, high-fidelity desktop WEB APP SCREEN, landscape 1440x1100 style proportions, front-on flat screen, no device mockup or surrounding room. Product: "wanna watch." a personal browser of films and series included in German streaming subscriptions, IMDb ranked. It must look like a genuinely usable polished app, with a wow effect and strong 1980s identity. Show the entire first viewport and substantial film posters. Exact main heading: "Tonight, sorted." Main functions must be clear and coherent: brand at top left, "GERMANY" top right; prominent heading and "Refresh catalog" button; "Your subscriptions" with Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Disney Plus and "Choose services"; Films / Series switch; compact labeled controls Minimum IMDb votes (1,000), Original language (English), Released after (Any year), Maximum IMDb rating (Any rating), Exclude genres, Reset filters; shelf navigation To discover / Watched / Hidden. Four real classic movie poster-style artworks in shelf: The Godfather, The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King, The Godfather Part II, The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring. Each has title and IMDb rating and Watched / Hide actions. Use this same content in all comparisons. Concept only, do not invent metrics, factual availability claims, testimonials, premium subscriptions, search, or features beyond the named controls. No fake browser chrome. Functional controls are legible modern UI size, not all pixel fonts. This is an operating catalog screen, not a marketing landing page. No eyebrow above the main headline.
NEON VIDEO STORE: inky midnight indigo background, vivid hot pink and electric cyan accents, memorable giant italic condensed 80s video-title lettering with tasteful luminous edges. Neon pink slanted underline and chrome-like thin line details, a sophisticated night-time rental club. One dominant illuminated sign treatment in the heading, calm readable filters. Tight rectangular control deck, poster sleeves subtly raised from background. Absolutely no generic purple SaaS gradient blobs. Upper section compact enough that all four poster images are visible. Stunning precise typography, restraint in glow, no illegible outline body text.
note: Design concept only. Poster artwork, incidental slogans and ratings are illustrative; implementation uses the real catalog. Analog EST. 1984 and trademark are generated errors and must be omitted.
